notes.title: Patch 1.2.20.0
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

Today is the 4th anniversary of The Last Spell, and what better way to celebrate that by releasing a good-old fashioned regular patch? 

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed contagion not being spread when a target has an immunity to a status,
[*] Fixed skills with cardinals not displaying the cardinal icon if their max range was equal to 1 without modifiers when hovering items in the city's inventory,
[*] Fixed bonepiles being loaded in the map if they had 0 hp left (happens when quitting the game after scavenging a bonepile without waiting for the destruction animation),
[*] Fixed trap icons being blank after taking the omen 'Omen of the Trapper',
[*] Fixed Dwarves and Elves being able to get the 'Leapfrog' perk in their perk tree after using perk reroll while having the omen 'Omen of Leaps',
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increases duration by 1 turn for all defensive attribute debuffs added by “Upgraded Enemies” apocalypse,
[*] Update of all scroll damage according to their respective skills,
[*] Reducing Abalone Seed range from 15 to 6,
[/list]

[h2]QoL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a perk tooltip alongside the race tooltip when the race has a perk,
[*] Added range preview when the perk Epidemic is selected,
[*] Modified attack preview secondary icons for dispel & purg
[/list]

Don't forget to update your game!

notes.title: Elves of Amberwald DLC OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

Today's the day! The newest DLC for The Last Spell, Elves of Amberwald, is finally available! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3023570/The_Last_Spell__Elves_of_Amberwald/

But first, let's take a look at the trailer:

[h1]RELEASE TRAILER[/h1]
[previewyoutube=_ExA-T9yv8g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Elves of Amberwald Features[/h1]
This new DLC brings a brand-new challenge to The Last Spell, with:
[list]
[*]A new map to defend: [b]Amberwald[/b]

This elven forest fights back against intruders with its own defenses. Paths appear and disappear, forcing foes to adapt their approach. And some say the trees feed off the blood of any with ill intent towards the forest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/262b24d0647458b5e10388fd18f8910bb14d003f.jpg[/img]


[*]A new race: [b]Elves[/b]

The Elves are joining the fray! Arrogant, relentless, and fiercely loyal to their sacred Nature, these warriors bring a unique flair to the battlefield with powerful perks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/a436184a21c3ef4acde948bd541879d0b40d7fa5.gif[/img]

[*]3 new weapons!

The Elves have come prepared, giving you their unique weapons that you’ll be able to unlock after the battle of Amberwald: 

[b]Claws[/b]: Dual one-handed melee weapons that gain multihit bonuses when striking isolated enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/7adc9086b6b589d9fefdb2b287823c977a2d3295.gif[/img]

[b]Boomerang[/b]: A one-handed ranged weapon with unique AOEs that stuns enemies to unleash additional deadly attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/15639feb90631312c01e62af931c29b4aaa1046b.gif[/img]

[b]Sacred Flower[/b]: A two-handed magical weapon that lets you poison enemies and amplify magic damage, but at the risk of getting interrupted and damaging yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/a4c97f9878c7b28d8d501a1ccad7aabecf808253.gif[/img]

[*]New Defenses: [b]Seeds[/b]

Seeds are a welcome help in this new fight! A new defense mechanic to turn the tide of battle with 3 different seeds to use:

[b]Snake Seeds[/b] inflict deadly poison on your enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/32affabfc3bc110ea49c2f0e854be9670efedb81.gif[/img]

[b]Falcon Seeds [/b]will attack Isolated foes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/dade2f929bec99e00a460dab56fa2b0afc491393.gif[/img]

[b]Abalone Seeds[/b] purge enemies of their bonuses and leave them vulnerable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/1ce925a6d652b525a01ecec5be520066c12cc72a.gif[/img]

[/list]


To celebrate its release, Elves of Amberwald is 10% off until next week, so don't miss it!

[h1]Free update: Apocalypse 2.0! Essence Rerolls! Base game balancing![/h1]

A free major update is also available for every player of The Last Spell, bringing:
[list]
[*][b]Apocalypse 2.0[/b]: a complete rework of the Apocalypse system

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/8d23626dff8a46421e0f31813ff24c42c875a98b.png[/img]


[*][b]Essence Rerolls![/b] After completing all other base game Favors, players can now unlock “Essence Rerolls”,allowing them to reroll Perks, Level Ups and Item Rewards in exchange for Tainted
Essence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/bb33fd25b577edc27d7255ac38c13e6a5c0a1d95.gif[/img]

[*][b]Base game balancing[/b] for weapons and perks
[*][b]Bugfixes & QoL[/b]
[/list]

We made a blogpost dedicated to the full changelog, so we suggest you to read it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1105670/view/532096041998090593

[h1]A plush for The Last Spell: Schaden![/h1]
A few weeks ago, we let players decide which character of The Last Spell universe they would like to have as a plush, and they chose Schaden!

We're very happy to announce that we're partnering with Makeship to create the Schaden plush for The Last Spell!

Today, the petition starts and will run for 10 days!

https://www.makeship.com/petitions/schaden

[u]How does it work?[/u]
1. Pledge $2 to help this Petition reach the 200 supporter goal
2. If this Petition reaches 200 unique supporters, the concept will become a real product!
3. You'll be charged the remaining balance (retail price and shipping) automatically when the Campaign launches

notes.title: Deep dive: Balancing blogpost!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

This is a very special blogpost, one that has been requested quite a while from players.

[h1]PREFACE[/h1]
Today, we want to tell you more about how today's balance changes came to be, and how we used the results of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1105670/view/435450276145030830]feedback form[/url] from a few month ago.
Before anything, I highly recommend you reading the changelog to see al the changes that were just released today!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1105670/view/532096041998090593

As you can imagine, analyzing all the results and working on everything took quite a while.

So, today, we want to tell you more about those changes!

Before anything, a little disclaimer : this balance patch is aimed specifically at Weapons and Perks. We have also gathered feedback on things like Buildings, Defenses, Bonepiles, etc… but these aspects of the game are more sensible, so we’re still taking our time to see what the best approach would be.

The first important thing to talk about is our approach to these changes. We’re not in early access anymore, so changing the balance of the game is a bit more touchy than before. This is why we had this question in the form :
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/a33bd14ede4e1d1145ce9002d164fa7e2c575d22.png[/img]

An overwhelming majority of players do not want any nerfs, or only to overpowered weapons. It’s what we expected, but it’s a good thing we could confirm it.
Now, our next problem was the discrepancy between the feedback we had been collecting in the Discord server and Steam forums up until now, and the feedback coming from the form. It’s also something we expected : players who take the time to write their thoughts on the game’s balance are often the most invested, and thus the most hardcore players, while a feedback form is open to anyone. I’ll give you two examples of discrepancies:

We have had multiple players on Discord agreeing that the Longbow is one of the worst weapons in the game. However, in the feedback form, the weapon scored slightly above average, with an estimated power level very close the the Power Staff. We even had slightly more players feeling like the Longbow is OP :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/76fddc90e287d75c95c2fb13bc586c0f23997085.png[/img]

As for perks, I’ll take the example of Sadist, who got very mixed reviews in the feedback form, while many players on discord see it as one of the most powerful perks. It scored way less than many other Tier 3 perks :
  
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/c4b481d39ce0922d333859e7cc7438ee560de4d9.png[/img]

As a bonus, using feedback from the form, here’s what the « average » weapon tier list would look like:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/a1a2eae23613ee08610841582256bf2066027375.png[/img]

So, how should we go about these differences ? We couldn’t just listen to the Discord feedback, as that would go against the opinion of the average player in many cases. But on the opposite, some balance problems only appear when playing at the highest levels of challenge. Balancing the game only with the average player in mind would probably end up making the game less balanced for hardcore players.

Taking all of this into account, here’s the approach we went with :
[list]
[*]If something is rated as OP in the feedback form AND in the Discord/Steam forums, we should slightly nerf it.
[*]Otherwise, no nerfs
[*]If something is seen as underpowered in the feedback form, we should buff it
[*]If something is seen as underpowered in the Discord/Steam forums, we should buff it
[/list]

Now, having talked about our intentions, let’s take a look at two individual cases to tell you how we think about balance changes.

[h2]Two-Handed Sword :[/h2]
The Two-Handed Sword was already on our radar before the survey, as it was considered one of the worst weapons on the discord server. This was confirmed by player responses : 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/b4b75814c6c10ace3d565a022f48ea2260a19658.png[/img]
 
This may seem like just a « slightly under average » result, but players tended to gravitate more heavily towards saying weapons are Strong/Very Strong on average, so this is a pretty bad score, just slightly better than the Rifle. The Two-Handed Sword was also the weapon for which players requested changes the most (nearly 50% of respondants!), with only the Rifle coming close :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/c9f934f9fef782e95b4c028ab9cc60f592ebe89b.png[/img]

 When rebalancing a weapon, we have many options available, ranging from simple damage tweaks to reworking skills or even implementing new ones. However, one rule we have is that the « feel » and soul of a weapon should NOT be changed anymore. For example, a weapon focused on single target assassination like the Rifle should not suddenly get a heavy damage dealing AoE, although that would certainly make it more powerful.

The Two-Handed Sword is meant to be a more heavy version of the Sword: a weapon focused on mobility and momentum, but that deals more damage and hits more targets at the cost of more action points, like other two-handed weapons. This is why the changes made to the weapon try to orient it into this direction even more : Heroes now gain movement after using the first skill, making it more worthy of its 2 Action Point cost. The fourth skill is now the first large AoE of the game using Momentum, but comes at the cost of movement. This makes the weapon generally interact more with the movement stat, and gives it a more strategic aspect, while also making it scale better : a Two-Handed sword wielder with a lot of Movement and Momentum should be much stronger and mobile than before.

[h2]Hand Crossbow :[/h2]
The Hand Crossbow is the ONLY weapon that was nerfed in this update, but not without reason, as it was pretty much the only weapon that everyone really agreed on being OP :
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/9eee5caac6dd47064ee18faadc08e1f2b1535f31.png[/img]
 
This was expected, as we know that the Multi-Hit mechanic scales extremely well, especially in the case of the Hand Crossbow, that only starts with 2 Hits (meaning every additional multi-hit grants +50% damage to the weapon). However, we have no easy solution to the multi-hit balance, so we had to change the weapon. 
Now, I’ll go through a few of the options we have tested out for nerfing the weapon, and why we didn’t go for that.

[b]Option 1 :[/b] Reducing base damage. This is the easy option, but something we rejeected as it made the weapon absolutely unusable in the earlier nights, before getting more Multi-hit. While we know that some weapons are already pretty weak in the erarly nights, we don’t want to take this too far.

[b]Option 2 :[/b] Reducing the base damage but increasing the Multi-hit as compensation. This was the most « balance-friendly » solution, and probably the one we would have taken if this was a competitive game. The damage total of the weapon on night 1 would be unchanged, but each Multi-hit gained would add much less damage than previously. The problem of this is that it made the weapon veeeery slow to play in the early nights, as you would have to choose 4 or five targets for each hit. Generally, the weapon suddenly had a very unpleasant feeling to it, having to shoot an enemy 7 or 8 times to kill it. The « feel » of weapons is very important to us, so we scrapped this option.  

[b]Option 3 : [/b]Changing the first skill to something else. This option was quickly dismissed, as we want the various weapons of the game to showcase all the different mechanics we have. We want to have a weapon that has Multi-hit on a basic attack, even if it makes it very hard to balance.

In the end, the solution we went for is to reduce the number of uses on the Multi-Hit skill. While the weapon will surely keep being the strongest in the game, this should reduce its strength cap compared to before, as you cannot use the skill more than 6 times in a turn now. In exchange, we have addeda use on the Poison skill, as we don’t want players to run out of actions to do on the first nights.

That’s pretty much it for the balance changes and the feedback form ! Once again, I’d like to sincerely thank all players that answered the survey, as your answers were very helpful to us. We hope you enjoy the free update and the Elves of Amberwald DLC !

And as a little bonus, here’s the score of the BOOM ! perk to the question « How much do you like this perk ? ». Do you think the overkill answers will propagate to adjacent targets ?
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/c9a4b0f97767b16c2be6fccc84a1d932dc3b3638.png[/img]

The fourth skill is now the first large AoE of the game using Momentum, but comes at the cost of movement.

In exchange, we have addeda use on the Poison skill, as we don’t want players to run out of actions to do on the first nights.

notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

Today's the day: Elves of Amberwald is available! And, as we previously announced, we're releasing a FREE update that brings a complete rework of the Apocalypse system, the essence rerolls, and a LOT of balancing.

And now... You've been waiting for it: the BIG changelog for this new version!

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]
tl;dr:
[list]
[*]Addition of the "Elves of Amberwald DLC"
[*]Apocalypse 2.0
[*]Essence rerolls
[*]Weapons Balancing
[*]Perks Balancing
[*]Bugfixes & QoL
[/list]


[h1]GENERAL [/h1]

[h2]Apocalypse 2.0 [/h2]
[list]
[*]Completely reworked the Apocalypse system: players can freely activate whichever Apocalypse modifiers they want, each of them increasing the Apocalypse Level by a certain amount.  
[*]Multiple new Apocalypse modifiers have been added, and some of them have multiple degrees of difficulty the player can choose from. 
[*]Players unlock the Apocalypse system with a base pool of modifiers. New modifiers can be unlocked by beating a map on Apocalypse Levels 6, 16 and 32. Players who had already beaten apocalypse levels will start with a certain level of progression, depending on the highest apocalypse level they beat. 
[*]A new menu, dedicated to selecting apocalypses, has been added. 
[*]The description of achievements concerning Apocalypse levels have been updated to match the new system 
[*]New achievements have been added for beating maps with 12 different modifiers and beating any map with 16 different modifiers. 
[/list]

[h2]Essence Rerolls [/h2]
[list]
[*] After completing all other base game Favors, players can now unlock “Essence Rerolls”, allowing them to reroll Perks, Level Ups and Item Rewards in exchange for Tainted Essence. 
[/list]

[h2]Other [/h2]
[list]
[*] The bonus experience granted to the killer of an enemy is now called “Killer Bonus”. This is used to clarify what perks affecting the Killer Bonus actually do. 
[*]Obstacles present at map start (like Lampposts and Rocks) do not block construction on adjacent tiles anymore. 
[*]Dwarves can now also be tossed using catapults 
[*]Dwarves now have a minimum Move Points limit of 4 and a maximum limit of 12 
[*]Reduced the amount of Action Points spent needed to unlock DLC Weapon variants (applies to Elves of Amberwald AND Dwarves of Runenberg). 
[*]After unlocking medals, a medals-only slot is added to the shop. 
[/list]

[b][h1]BALANCING [/h1][/b]

[h1]WEAPONS [/h1]
[h2]Physical weapons [/h2]

[h3]Axe [/h3]
Base Damage at level 0: 65-97 -> 69-105 

[h3]Great Axe [/h3]
Base Damage at level 0: 82-123 -> 82-136 

[u]Rage (Skill 3): [/u]
[list]
[*]Buff: +25% Damage (2 Turns), up to +35% -> +30% Damage (2 Turns), up to +40% at level 5 
[*]Debuff: -10% Resistance (2 Turns) -> -20% Resistance (2 Turns) 
[/list]

[u]Super Spin (Skill 4): [/u]
[list]
[*] Added Caster Effect: Apply Dispel (All Debuffs) 
[/list]

[h3]Hammer [/h3]
Base Damage at level 0: 109-129 -> 124-144 

[u]Stomp (Skill 3): [/u]
[list]
[*] Primary tile: DMG x1 (109-129) -> DMG x1.5 (186-216) 
[/list]

[h3]Two-Handed Sword [/h3]
Base Damage at level 0: 101-138 -> 111-149 

[u]Slash (Skill 1): [/u]
[list]
[*] Added Caster Effect: Restore 3 Move Points 
[/list]

[u]Sword Blast (Skill 4): [/u]
[list]
[*]Cost: 2 AP, 3 Mana -> 2 AP, 2 Move, 1 Mana 
[*]Added: Momentum +10% 
[*]DMG x1 (101-138) -> DMG x0.75 (83-112) 
[/list]

[h2]Ranged weapons[/h2] 

[h3]Crossbow [/h3]
Base damage at level 0: 90-110 -> 100-130 

[u]Straight Shot (Skill 1): [/u]
[list]
[*]Added Debuff: -5% Resistance (1 Turn) (up to –10% at level 5) 
[/list]

[h3]Hand Crossbow [/h3]

Quickshot (Skill 1): 
[list]
[*]Uses per turn: 4 -> 3 
[/list]

[u]Slow Death (Skill 2): [/u]
[list]
[*]Uses per turn: 2 -> 3 
[*]Debuff: -2 Move (2 Turns) -> -1 Move (3 Turns) 
[/list]

[h3]Longbow [/h3]
Base damage at level 0: 70-101 -> 78-120 

[u]Long Shot (Skill 1): [/u]
[list]
[*]Uses per turn: 4 -> 5 
[/list]

[u]Watch Out (Skill 2): [/u]
[list]
[*]Added Buff: +15% Accuracy (1 Turn), up to +25% at level 5 
[/list]

[u]Snipe Shot (Skill 3): [/u]
[list]
[*]Uses per turn: 2 -> 3 
[*]Cost: 1 AP, 1 Move, 2 Mana -> 1 AP, 1 Move, 1 Mana 
[*]Range: 7-14 -> 7-18 
[/list]

[u]Arctic Blast (Skill 4): [/u]
[list]
[*]Stun Chance: 60% -> 70% 
[/list]

[h3]Rifle [/h3]
Base damage at level 0: 135-169 -> 145-185 

[h3]Shortbow [/h3]
Base damage at level 0: 75-109 -> 84-118 

[u]Tight Volley (Skill 3): [/u]
[list]
[*]Debuff: -2 Move (2 Turns) -> -3 Move (2 Turns) 
[/list]

[h2]Magical Weapons [/h2]

[h3]Druidic Staff [/h3]

[u]Acid Spray (Skill 3): [/u]
[list]
[*]Debuff: -150 Armor (2 Turns), up to –300 at level 5 -> -250 Armor (2 Turns), up to –500 at level 5 
[*]Debuff: -10% Dodge (2 Turns), up to –30% at level 5 -> -25% Dodge (2 Turns), up to –50% Dodge at level 5 
[/list]

[h2]Orb [/h2]
Base damage at level 0: 60-77 -> 71-93 

[u]Putrid Ball (Skill 2): [/u]
[list]
[*] Primary Target: DMG x1.25 (75-96) -> DMG x2 (142-186)
[/list] 

[u]Death Ray (Skill 3): [/u]
[list]
[*]DMG x2 (120-154) -> DMG x4 (284-372) 
[/list]

[h1]PERKS [/h1]

[h2]Tier 1 [/h2]

[h3]Cheer [/h3]
Perk reworked. 

[u]Old Effect: [/u]
Unlocks the Cheer skill, allowing to Buff the Damage of an ally. (1-10 Range, +15% Damage) 
-> 
[u]New Effect: [/u]
At the start of the Heroes’ turn, the Hero automatically casts Cheer on the closest allied Hero, buffing their Damage. (1-15 Range, +15% Damage) 

[h3]Cherry Picking [/h3]
[list]
[*]Reliability bonus: +40% -> +75% 
[/list]

[h3]Fatality [/h3]
Perk effects changed. 

[u]Old effect : [/u]
Unlocks the Fatality skill, allowing to Execute any enemy in melee range under 10 Health. This threshold is increased by 3 for each Level of the Hero. 
-> 
[u]New Effect: [/u]
Unlocks the Fatality skill, allowing to Execute any enemy in melee range under 15 Health. This threshold is increased by 1 for every 1% Physical Damage after 100%. 

[h3]Steady Aim [/h3]
[list]
[*]Skill Range bonus: +1 -> +2 
[/list]

[h3]Perseverance [/h3]
Perk effects changed. 

[u]Old Effect: [/u]
Every 2 attacks from the Hero dodged by at least one unit: Restore 1 Action Point. +5% Accuracy (2 Turns) 
-> 
[u]New Effect: [/u]
Once per turn, when an attack from the Hero is dodged by at least one unit: Restore 2 Action Points. +10% Accuracy (2 Turns). 

[h2]Tier 2 [/h2]
[h3]Crippling Punch [/h3]
Now has an additional effect: 

Every 1 enemies killed using Crippling Punch, its base damage is increased by 1. The amount of enemies to kill to get bonus damage is increased by 1 every 100 bonus damage obtained. 

[h3]Defensive Training[/h3]
Description changed to clarify the effects of the perk. The effects remain unchanged. 

[u]New Description : [/u]
Enemies killed by defenses now grant the Killer Bonus to this Hero. 

[h2]Tier 3 [/h2]
[h3]Initiator [/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed the –10% Damage malus. 
[/list]

[h3]Longer Weapons [/h3]
Perk effects changed. 

[u]Old Effect: [/u]
+2 Skill Range. -15% Reliability. 
-> 
[u]New Effect: [/u]
+2 Skill Range. When attacking a unit at a distance of 5 tiles or less, the attack gets: Unreliable x1,5. 

[h3]One by One [/h3]
[list]
[*]Damage bonus per killed enemy: 4% -> 7% 
[*]Damage bonus per killed enemy (melee): 6% -> 10% 
[*]Damage cap: 60% -> 80% 
[*]Damage lost on hitting a non-isolated unit: -6% -> -4% 
[/list]

[h3]Quantity vs Quality [/h3]
Perk reworked. 
[list]
[*]Name changed to “Quality over Quantity” 
[/list]
[u]
New Effect: [/u]
All of the Hero’s Propagation Bounces is transformed into Propagation Damage (conversion rate: 800%). Increases Maximum Propagation Damage to 150% 

[h3]Resupply [/h3]
Perk reworked. 
[list]
[*]Name changed to “Manual Control” 
[/list]

[u]New Effect: [/u]
When the Hero is next to a Catapult, Ballista or Trap, unlocks a special skill allowing to use the effects of that defense. 

[h3]Runic Gift [/h3]
[list]
[*]Is now a Tier 4 Perk 
[/list]

[h3]Sadist 
[/h3]
[list]
[*]Is now a Tier 4 Perk. 
[/list]

[h3]Shorter Weapons [/h3]
Perk effects changed. 

[u]Old Effect: [/u]
-1 Skill Range. +15% Accuracy. +20% Reliability 
-> 
[u]New Effect: [/u]
-2 Skill Range. When attacking a unit at a distance of 2 to 6 tiles, the attack gets: Undodgeable. 

[h3]Toxic Leech [/h3]
[list]
[*]Range: 5 -> 6 
[*]Health Restored: 2 -> 3 
[/list]

[h2]Tier 4 [/h2]
[h3]Bully [/h3]
[list]
[*]Is now a Tier 3 Perk 
[*]Critical Power malus: -15% -> -10% 
[/list]

[h3]Epidemic [/h3]
Perk reworked. 
[u]Old Effect: [/u]
When applying Poison to a unit, also apply Contagion (2 Turns). 
-> 
[u]New Effect : [/u]
Every 3 enemies Poisoned, apply: 30 Poison (2 Turns) and Contagion (2 Turns) to the closest enemy without Contagion in a range of 10. 

[h3]Field Study [/h3]
[list]
[*]Now has an additional effect: 
[*]Increases Maximum Skill Range to 16. 
[/list]

[h3]Mana Shield [/h3]
[list]
[*]Is now a Tier 3 Perk 
[/list]

[h3]Specialist [/h3]
[list]
[*]Damage Bonus: +50% -> +40% 
[*]Now grants +1 Action Point
[*]Additional uses on skills: +1 -> +2 
[*]Additional uses now only apply to main hand weapon skills 
[/list]

[h2]Tier 5 [/h2]

[h3]Don’t Panic [/h3]
Perk effects changed. 

[u]Old Effect: [/u]
When attacking a tile located inside the Haven, the attack gets: +15% Accuracy. +40% Perk Damage. 
-> 
[u]New Effect: [/u]
When attacking a tile located inside the Haven, the attack gets: Vision. Cannot damage friendly buildings. +15% Accuracy. +40% Perk Damage

[h3]Surgical Strike [/h3]
Perk reworked. 
[list]
[*]Name changed to “Surgical Strikes” 
[/list]
[u]New Effect: [/u]
After attacking and killing an enemy unit that was at full Health and at a range of 5 or more, the Hero's next skill costs Move Points instead of Action Points, at 1.5x the original cost (rounded up). 

While the Hero has 3 Move Points or less, Skills will cost Action Points, but the effects of the perk will not be consumed when using a skill. 

[h2]Dwarves Perks [/h2]
[h3]Bodycount Contest (Dwarves of Runenberg DLC) [/h3]
Description changed to clarify the effects of the perk. The effects remain unchanged. 
[u]New Description : [/u]
As long as there is a Hero in a range of 12: Killing an enemy grants +120% Killer Bonus. 

[h3]Look at my Muscles (Dwarves of Runenberg DLC) [/h3]
[list]
[*]Now grants +1 skill use on every weapon skill 
[/list]

[h3]Tossable Fellow (Dwarves of Runenberg DLC) [/h3]
[list]
[*]Skill Range : 5 -> 10 
[*]New Skill : Hurl.. Dwarf? 
[/list]

[h3]REALLY Tossable Fellow (Dwarves of Runenberg DLC) [/h3]
[list]
[*]Skill Range : 6 -> 12 
[/list]

[h3]Warcry (Dwarves of Runenberg DLC)[/h3] 
[list]
[*]Health/Armor threshold: 20 -> 15 
[/list]

[h3]Heart of the Party (Dwarves of Runenberg DLC) [/h3]
[list]
[*]Armor Buff: +3 Armor (2 Turns) -> +7 Armor (1 Turn) 
[/list]
 
[h1]BUGFIXES & QOL [/h1]

[h2]QOL [/h2]
[list]
[*]Added tooltips in the Save Slots screen for Apocalypse, Omens and Weapon Restrictions 
[*]Improved feedback when a save is corrupted 
[/list]

[h2]Bugfix [/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the damage of Scroll of Magic Missiles being inconsistent with the damage of the original skill. 
[*]Fixed "will die by poison" feedback not being displayed when loading a game 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a black screen when checking hero pages in the victory screen. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a black screen when checking perk screen when reviewing heroes at the end of a run 
[*]Fixed a visual bug where boomers stayed alive when they killed a hero during their explosion (while the hero had their death animation) 
[*]Fixed Kindled disappearing when changing direction between front and back 
[*]Fixed an item tooltip bug where the part containing the skills and perks icons sometimes went above the part with the current skill / perk name 
[*]Fixed omen button being selected by default when entering world map (Joystick Controls) 
[*]Fixed omen tooltip not hiding when an omen tooltip from a selected city is displayed and another city is selected (Joystick Controls) 
[*]Fixed omen button not being selected after closing the weapons restrictions popup while a city is selected (Joystick Controls) 
[/list]
 
Phew, I think that's all!

notes.title: Elves of Amberwald will release on April 22nd!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

You were waiting for this one, and we're VERY happy to finally announce it, and it's coming out way sooner than you thought ;)

[h1]The second DLC for The Last Spell, called "Elves of Amberwald", will be released on April 22nd![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/4e606847c9cc46d8a1e4e589736108974caa7531.png[/img]

You can already add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3023570/The_Last_Spell__Elves_of_Amberwald/
[h1]
What's new in Elves of Amberwald?[/h1]

In Elves of Amberwald, you will fight in the sacred forest of Amberwald alongside Elves against hordes of monsters, including an exclusive boss that was never seen before...

[b][list]
[*]A new map to defend: Amberwald

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/54dbdde16fb139ded1c8a505b8e17bc2c3ed24e7.jpg[/img]


[*]A new race is joining the fight: Elves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/a436184a21c3ef4acde948bd541879d0b40d7fa5.gif[/img]

[*]3 new weapons: Claws, Boomerang, Sacred Flower

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/52ad1d7dceb70f52fab8d3a535cd689ae844df54.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/5c387c2bd3ae531568c738ae25d10c857beb9b19.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/e4ecd080cbc63755d13b9b21a09393343087d738.gif[/img]


[*]New defenses: Seeds

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/32affabfc3bc110ea49c2f0e854be9670efedb81.gif[/img]

[/list][/b]

We also want to thank our amazing beta testers who [strike]broke [/strike]played the DLC a few weeks ago and gave us invaluable feedback!

[h1]FREE PATCH - Apocalypse 2.0[/h1]
That one was a HUGE work for us. We basically broke the current apocalypse system and created a new system that we're calling the "Apocalypse 2.0"

This new system will allow you to tailor the apocalypse level on any map, providing a personalized challenge. No more one-size-fits-all—adjust the difficulty as you see fit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/8d23626dff8a46421e0f31813ff24c42c875a98b.png[/img]

Apocalypse 2.0 will be released alongside the DLC 2 on April 22nd.

[h1]FREE PATCH - BASE GAME BALANCING[/h1]
One of the most requested change to bring to The Last Spell was some base game balancing. As you can imagine, this is a lot of work, but we felt that it was necessary.

To tease you about them:
[list]
[*]Weapons balancing
[*]Perks balancing
[*]Dwarves Perks balancing
[*]QoL & Bugfix
[/list]

Apocalypse 2.0 and the base game balancing will be released alongside the DLC as a free update, so all players will have something to look forward to!

notes.title: New Mode: Boss Rush!!
notes.content:
You asked for it, we listened!

[strike]We know a lot of you were asking for building rotation![/strike]
…
Well, that one is hopeless…

But, we know a lot of you were also asking for a playable version of the tutorial map. You know, the one called Runenlicht. No, was it Lakewald ? No, no, something with “Gl…”, Glentberg ? Gloomfein ? Goldenburg ? Lakeborg ? Rumenberg ? Amperwattz ? Ah, here, found it, Swampfurt!
Regardless, the base version of Swampfurt was a bit too short for some of you. 

[h1]We present to you: Swampfurt 2.0[/h1]

Before today, no one could actually protect Swampfurt (except maybe a wall of 40 Ballistae). After the 2nd night, the Magic Circle would die no matter what, and players would meet the two mysterious beings for the very first time, and then they were never supposed to go back.

We know a lot of you were frustrated that you can’t go back to Swampfurt later in the game. Well, we made the decision of allowing you to revisit Swampfurt in a VERY special way that you’ll probably (maybe, hopefully)~[strike]cheese with hand crosbows[/strike]~~ love. love.

We thought:
[list]
[*] Players want to go back to Swampfurt
[*] Players loved the bosses of the game
[*] Players abuse the corpse strat love corpse piles and want 80% of the map to be Haven tiles
[/list]

So, why not have both?

[h1]Introducing… A boss rush in Swampfurt!![/h1]

That’s right, all the bosses you all learned to love (and kill) are joining the party!
[list]
[*] Harpies
[*] Cetusias
[*] The Dryad
[*] The Archivists
[*] The two final bosses
[/list]

And since we know fighting each boss separately is a bit too easy for you, we’ve prepared a VERY special night, but we’ll leave you the pleasure of discovering it by yourself :eyes: 


……

[b]And now… APRIL’S FO…[/b]

…

…

You thought this was just an innocent April’s fools fake blogpost and that we didn’t actually do it, right? 
Well, just try to go to the special “NEWSWAMPFURT” branch, and you will see…

How to switch branches?

Head over to:
[list]
[*] TLS in your Steam Library
[*] Settings
[*] Properties
[*] Betas
[*] Copy/paste this code in Betas to get access to the DLC branch: looflirpassoB
[/list]

[h1]!!WARNING: ABOUT THE SAVES!![/h1]
This will be on a separate branch. That means that you will NOT be able to use your save as it is currently for this branch.
To use your current save:

[list]
[*] In your local files, head over to %Appdata%/../LocalLow/Ishtar Games/The Last Spell/Save/Steam/[YOURSTEAMID]/
[*] Go to the profile you want to use
[*] Duplicate the "AppSave.bin", and rename the new file to "AppSaveBeta.bin"
[*] ONLY USE A DUPLICATE OF YOUR FILE. DO NOT DIRECTLY RENAME YOUR SAVE FILE, or you will NOT be able to re-use it on the main branch after.
[/list]

Happy fighting!

notes.title: DLC 2 Blogpost: discover the new map, Amberwald!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!


We hope you’re okay! :) Spring is here, which means we’re VERY close to announcing the release date of the new DLC, along with the Steam page, and… the actual release. We thank you for your patience, it will be worth it ;) 

So, regarding the DLC, we already talked about the new weapons, the new race… what else? Ah that’s right: the new map. THE one place where those damned mages will still be struggling to summon that last spell. 
(No, this will unfortunately not be a beach DLC where heroes are just having fun on the beach as they play volleyball with the clawers). Let’s talk about Amberwald, the 8th map that we’re making for The Last Spell!

[h1]Amberwald[/h1]

As an elven-themed DLC, you will fight in the forest of [b]Amberwald[/b]. Located not too far from Glenwald (yeah, we miss those dryads too), this sacred forest is a biiit special. Directly connected to the Elves, they say that this forest has a very mysterious amber. What does that mean?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/262b24d0647458b5e10388fd18f8910bb14d003f.jpg[/img]

The main theme, as you may have guessed, was that this map needed to have a “forest” theme, but different than Glenwald. You will notice huge roots that are running beneath your Heroes' feet. Some say those roots have a deep and ancient connection to the magic that lies in the forest. The mages may be risking it all, but that may be their safest bet to cast the Last Spell. 

[h1]Sprouts[/h1]

Amberwald is alive... It knows your Heroes (and the mages) need to save the world from the Apocalypse, and will help you with all its centuries-old powers. At night, the forest wakes up and will defend against anyone trying to attack it or the people inside.

[list]
[*] Living Hardwood Sprouts
[/list]
They can grow into [b]Living Hardwood[/b], an indestructible wooden wall blocking Vision. When it grows, it will kill any monster on the tile. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/b56cbc36e6117c3ecfaa04316d5cb126da901fd3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/d19287f8cb87dc7fd4ca60a6ea9f4862ce5fc87e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Living Thornwood Sprouts
[/list]
They can grow into [b]Living Thornwood[/b], an indestructible wall of thorny wood, blocking Vision and attacking monsters. Also, when it grows, it will kill any monster on the tile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/70566b1871e747a140b1403194a2eafa820a29dc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/d2e102bb5a3a98b7fc25396ea71de2480937f800.png[/img]


Amber-Infused Sprout
This is the last type of sprout and is very special. It reacts to the mages casting the Last Spell. It will protect your heroes when they’re in its area. Also, rumor has it that if you protect them long enough, they will help you in a very different way when you need it the most…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/1ce925a6d652b525a01ecec5be520066c12cc72a.gif[/img]

[h1]Introduction of new Seeds[/h1]

In the new DLC, you will also be introduced to new seeds! They will be a new defense mechanic that will help you turn the tide of the battle.


[b]Snake Seeds[/b]. Those seeds will have 2 different effects:
[list]
[*] Poison: all units surrounding the seed will be poisoned
[*] Contagion:  when the unit dies, the negative alterations (including poison) will be applied to 2 adjacent units[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/32affabfc3bc110ea49c2f0e854be9670efedb81.gif[/img]

[b]Falcon Seeds[/b] can be used at night to deal damage to isolated enemies:
[list]
[*] Multi-hit X3
[*] Isolation: more damage to isolated enemies!
[*] Undodgeable
[*] And the skill doesn’t require a direct line of sight to the target!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/dade2f929bec99e00a460dab56fa2b0afc491393.gif[/img]

[b]Abalone Seeds[/b] purge enemies of their bonuses and leave them vulnerable:
[list]
[*] Will decrease their resistance for a given duration
[*] Will remove all positive alterations
[*] And doesn’t require a direct line of sight to the target!
[*] Also, the range for this one is huge!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/fbd0f6bcbb97b96b13ed10924e8806cf634cf779.gif[/img]

[b]One final note: the seeds is a brand new defense for the game, and will also be available for other maps![/b]

[h1]An Epic Conclusion[/h1]

As usual, the last night of this map will be a very special one with a new boss mechanic that makes for an epic finale. This time, we’re introducing [b]the [u]Gangrenous Fleshclouds[/u], that will challenge your wits to destroy your magic circle.[/b]
ALERT: SPOILER! So only clic on it if you’re not afraid of a spoiler about its design ;)

[spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/8322b00b8c9aa4f461f2ce341c4f0e88b464c436.png[/img][/spoiler]

Fun fact: the concept for the boss of Amberwald is actually heavily inspired from a very early and unused (until now) concept for The Last Spell that was made in… 2019!


What better way to destroy a forest than… from the sky? We won’t tell you too much about the boss in itself, but just know that they’ll stop at nothing to attack your magic circle, and there will be lots of them.
However, don’t think for one second that the forest will let itself be destroyed without fighting back. Protecting the sprouts during the nights before will definitely be worth it.


Aaaand that’s it for today! I think we talked about all major stuff that will be in the DLC!

Next blogpost will very likely be the release date announcement! And we still need to talk about the free patch that will bring the much anticipated Apocalypse 2.0 as well as some balancing on the base game that we know you’ve been asking for a long time.
(we will buff the hand crossbow [spoiler](it’s a joke, please don’t hurt us)[/spoiler]).

- Amber-Infused Sprout This is the last type of sprout and is very special. It reacts to the mages casting the Last Spell. It will protect your heroes when they’re in its area. Also, rumor has it that if you protect them long enough, they will help you in a very different way when you need it the most…

- Living Thornwood Sprouts They can grow into Living Thornwood, an indestructible wall of thorny wood, blocking Vision and attacking monsters. Also, when it grows, it will kill any monster on the tile.
- Living Hardwood Sprouts They can grow into Living Hardwood, an indestructible wooden wall blocking Vision. When it grows, it will kill any monster on the tile.
- Let’s talk about Amberwald, the 8th map that we’re making for The Last Spell!

notes.title: DLC 2 Blogpost: New Weapons!
notes.content:
Hello warriors!

The release of the new DLC is approaching, slowly but surely… (this spring!)

A very closed beta is taking place as we speak to get some feedback before the release. We’re very happy, because most of the design choices are proving to be a success with players! And we still got some time to make some tweaks to make sure everything is ready for the release.

Today, our main focus will be about WEAPONS. In this Elven DLC, there are 3 new weapons that you’re going to be able to use! They bring even more strategy to the game. (but we know SOME of you will just play the map with punches only, so…).

[h2]Claws[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/52ad1d7dceb70f52fab8d3a535cd689ae844df54.gif[/img]

Claws are a 2-handed melee weapon focused on isolating targets and killing them. Their weapon perk, Blood Drinker, allows the Weapon to temporarily gain Multi-hit on all attacks after hitting a certain number of isolated units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/c68158e6fd0df7a4c1ccc5b6420d84342ec83030.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Tearing Grasp is a flippable skill, a new feature introduced in this DLC. It can hit up to 2 targets for a single Action Point, allowing you to create isolated targets or activate Blood Drinker.
[*] Sharpen Claws is a simple buff that gives Physical Damage and Reliability. Reliability is important on Claws, as the damage range of this weapon is very high.
[*] Shadow Steps is a Maneuver skill that allows you to move wherever you want in a certain range, and also deal heavy damage to a target.
[*] Piercing Claws is an AoE skill that is great for creating isolated targets, but can also be insanely strong when combined with the Multi-hit of Blood Drinker.
[/list]

[h2]Boomerang[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/06dfc032f718981e4e8f72d9a6886447aa808ec0.gif[/img]

The Boomerang is a one-handed ranged weapon focused on stunning enemies. Its weapon perk, Strong Throw, will send bonus attacks -named "Ricochets"- at stunned enemies after each Boomerang skill you cast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/1f3c71a13c0267d9eed6153df316bfd10cf66185.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Precise Targeting is a multi-hit skill that has a chance to stun enemies. This attack easily lets you stun multiple enemies to activate Strong Throw.
[*] Crescent Swing is an AoE attack that can hit and stun many enemies for a low cost, but has a very specific shape, making it harder to use. To compensate, the skill has Vision, allowing you to hit enemies behind Trees or other Obstacles.
[*] Painful Spin is a large AoE attack that can stun even more enemies, allowing to clear through a mass of enemies at once, and trigger many Ricochets. However, it can only be cast in cardinal directions, making positioning key when using this skill.
[/list]

[h2]Sacred Flower[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/e4ecd080cbc63755d13b9b21a09393343087d738.gif[/img]

The Sacred Flower is a two-handed magic weapon focused on poison. Its weapon perk, Blight Blossom, builds up stacks of Plague every time the Hero uses Sacred Flower skills. Plague stacks grant bonus magic damage, but also increas the damage of Cleansing Spores. But be careful : if the Hero is hit by an attack while having Plague stacks, they will cast a botched version of Cleansing Spores, poisoning the Hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/579edbe8cc83ed93c4b6da29a9eb3d2fc404ae46.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Death Flower is a single target skill that also poisons 3 adjacent targets. It can quickly poison many enemies.
[*] Cleansing Spores is an ability with multiple effects : it applies poison to enemies in a large AoE, depending on how many plague stacks you have, but also removes any negative alterations on the Hero and removes any stacks of plague.
[*] Contagious Pollen is both a mobility skill, and the first weapon skill in the game that can apply contagion. Since the Sacred Flower has a relatively low skill range, you can use it to get into the midst of battle, but also to get out of it and not trigger Blight Blossom by getting hit.
[*] Petal Storm is a very large damaging AoE spell. It also removes any debuffs from the enemies it hits, which can be very useful against some enemies. Thanks to its very high AP and Mana cost, you can use this skill to build up a lot of Plague stacks at once, if you have the resources to do so.
[/list]

We hope you’ll find fun and creative ways to use those new weapons!

The new weapons will be available in the DLC 2 of The Last Spell, coming out this spring!

notes.title: Upcoming DLC new race: Elves!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

We hope you’re alright! :) We’re VERY happy to finally have the very first blogpost about the upcoming DLC, and this time, [b]it's all about NEW race for The Last Spell: elves! [/b]
We’re now putting the last touches on this DLC, betatesting, localizing, and we will sooooon be ready to release it. We’re also incredibly excited by this DLC, as we will also have a free update for [b]the much-anticipated Apocalypse 2.0, that some of you got to try last month![/b]

We also want to thank you for the nice love and support you’ve all been giving us throughout the years. We read every single of your message, positive and negative, and we’re working hard on making the game even better! We hope you’ll like what we have planned for the future of The Last Spell.


[b]Elves are just one part of the upcoming DLC for The Last Spell (releasing this spring!!), and they will be our very first focus![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/a436184a21c3ef4acde948bd541879d0b40d7fa5.gif[/img]


[h2]Elves, the Protectors of Nature[/h2]

In the world of The Last Spell, elves are NOT the social/fun ones. They would rather live with their dear forest and never hear about any other race or being.
Legends say that elves used to be so strong, a few of them was all it took to annihilate an army of hundreds of humans trying to destroy their dear forest. That’s how strong they were. 

When the Cataclysm happened, they all thought they could at least save their dear forest. After all, wasn’t it their mission in this world?

Naturally, some of the surviving elves tried to eradicate those monsters by themselves to restore the forest. Not that they didn’t know about the plan to cast the Last Spell. But they had no faith in those “useless, incompetent mages who can’t even defend themselves”, and quite a lot of them would rather have died than fighting alongside… “inferior races”. But when they saw the vision of the forest completely lifeless and corrupted, most of the surviving elves lost their reason. They got mad and ran into the mist in a vain hope they could still restore what was lost forever. Of course, they were never seen again.

So, the few elves that were still alive did something they did NOT want to do. But if it meant saving their forest, they were willing to do whatever it took. They reached out to humans and dwarves, and reluctantly asked for help. But don’t believe for one second that they’ve become team players or anything that sort. They will just be as arrogant as they used to be. You’ll meet Elves in the city of Amberwald for the very first time in DLC 2.

As you can see, elves are PROUD, FIERCE, and LOVE nature beyond reason. They will do whatever it takes to protect it. Nature is not just their homes. It’s part of them. They believe it’s alive, and must be protected at ALL COSTS.

One thing the elves hate is weakness. You know about survival of the fittest? Well, elves believe in survival of only the strongest. Weak ones shouldn’t have their place in this world.

But even the strongest of them might not be enough against those damned monsters…


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/d5596ec70b94cf6cd15d549e62b129e36708bef5.png[/img]

[h2]New Perks[/h2]
You know the drill, a new race means NEW PERKS! One thing we like to do for The Last Spell is making perks match the nature of their race.
For the Elves, we kept in mind 3 main characteristics about them to define their perks:

[h3]They’re HUNTERS. They consider themselves to be the protectors of nature. And they WILL protect it, killing any soul that would have the audacity to think about hurting nature.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Deadly Ranger grants Critical or Critical Damage to a Hero depending on what weapons they have equipped, allowing Elves to become strong assassins.
[/list]

[h3]They’re AGILE. Elves have high mobility, and dodging attacks is never an issue for those arrogant warriors. 
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Flicker Strike grants bonus damage to skills using Maneuver or Follow, depending on how far the target is. This encourages playing around mobility, which Elves already have a lot of.
[/list]

[h3]They HATE anything that changes their dear nature. Venturing beyond the town walls strengthens them, making them deadly hunters. They THRIVE outside the city.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Into The Wild is the native perk of Elves, granting them a malus to damage when inside the Haven, but a bonus to Accuracy when outside the Haven.
[/list]

Those are just a few of the perks that elves will be able to get in the upcoming DLC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/4aba6a043f05328c7efda557bab0343104dfd8c3.png[/img]

Are you looking forward to playing with the elves in The Last Spell?

Next time, we will tell you more about the mysterious new town: Amberwald, and its many secrets…


See you, Heroes! <3

- Into The Wild is the native perk of Elves, granting them a malus to damage when inside the Haven, but a bonus to Accuracy when outside the Haven.

notes.title: Beta Test: Apocalypse 2.0!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

We promised that we would talk to you a lot more from now on, didn't we? ;)

[h2]We've Revamped the Apocalypse System![/h2]
Our apocalypse system is undergoing a major overhaul to offer a more modular and customizable experience.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1105670/view/4354502761450308305]We asked you last summer[/url] to tell us which improvements were most important to you. What stood out was the need for personalization, with the possibility of modifiers that would have a greater impact on gameplay and change your habits and strategy. You can now fine-tune the difficulty to match your playstyle (and maybe discover new playstyles).

[b]Key Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]
Modular Difficulty Customization:
  The new system allows you to tailor the apocalypse level on any map, providing a personalized challenge. No more one-size-fits-all—adjust the difficulty as you see fit!
    
[*]Progressive Apocalypse Modifiers Unlocking:
  Previously, you had to complete one apocalypse to unlock the next. Now, affixes unlock progressively as you conquer maps with sufficiently high apocalypse levels. This step-by-step approach ensures a smoother progression and rewards your achievements at every stage.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/c5cd9c1fb96680dc873db1f4a5a8cc1ea5f6d619.jpg[/img]
Yep, that's "Apocalypse 15". You should have fun with that one!

[b]Goals of the New System:[/b]   
[list]
[*] Tailored Challenges:
Our aim is to help you find the perfect difficulty setting for any map. The modular design also allows us to introduce new levels and modifiers over time, keeping the experience fresh and engaging.

[*] Beta Feedback:
This beta phase will help us gather valuable insights on how you interact with the new system. We want to understand the challenges you face and ensure the tier unlocking speed meets your expectations.[/list]

[b]A More Challenging Experience:[/b]

The revamped system is designed to be more demanding. For example, what was once Apocalypse 6 is now equivalent to Apocalypse 11. However, you might find a new Apocalypse 15 easier than the old 6, as it can be more aligned with your playstyle.

We’re excited to see how you adapt to these changes and hope you enjoy all the new features!

[b]Apocalypse modifiers :[/b]

[list]
[*] Increase enemy Health: Enemies have +15/30/45% Health.
[*] Higher Building costs: Buildings cost +12/24/36% Gold.
[*] Less starting Mages: The Magic Circle starts with 75% Health remaining.
[*] Increase Boss HP: Bosses have +100/200/300% Health.
[*] More Panic: Increases Panic gains by +100%.
[*] Negative Affixes: Items can have negative stat gains.
[*] Increase Wave size: Enemy waves have 15/30/45% more enemies.
[*] No Defenses around Circle: You cannot build defenses in a range of 3 around the magic circle.
[*] Higher Defenses costs: Defenses cost +20/40/60% Materials.
[*] Faster Enemies: Enemies have +1 Movement Points (Runners, Crawlers, and Winged have +2 instead).
[*] Mist Censers: Mist Censers appear, spreading Thin Mist in the battlefield.
[*] Heroes Block Vision: Heroes now block vision.
[*] Building Deadzone: You cannot place buildings in a range of 2 tiles around [Houses]/[Houses, Production Buildings, and Mines]/[each other], instead of 1.
[*] Start with only 1 Hero: Start with -2 heroes. Doesn't impact hero max capacity.
[*] Closer Fog: The fog starts closer to the Haven.
[*] Super Elite Affixes: Elites can have upgraded bonuses.
[*] Upgraded Enemies: All standard enemies have one of their Skills upgraded.
[/list]

[h2]Known issues[/h2]

[list]
[*]"No defenses around Circle": It's currently possible to build Teleporters and watchtowers in the exclusion area while it shouldn't be possible
[/list]

[h3][u][b]
Important note: This is an [b]EARLY BETA[/b] of the new Apocalypse system. This means that the UI and the feedbacks are NOT final, and there's NO controller support for the Beta.[/b][/u][/h3]

[h2]How to access the Beta branch?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Go to your Steam game library.
[*]Right click on The Last Spell and click "properties".
[*]Select the tab "Betas".
[*]Copy/paste this code in Betas to get access to the DLC branch: ApocalypseRework
[*]In the first dropdown box select "Beta".
[*]Click close and wait for the upload to finish downloading.
[*]Start playing.
[/list]

[h2]About the saves[/h2]
The saves for this Beta will be different than the saves for the main branch. This means that you won't have any risk of losing your current save while changing branch. 
To play the Beta with saves, you have two ways:
[b][u]IF YOU WANT TO USE A PRE-MADE SAVE:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Go to your Steam game library
[*]Right click on The Last Spell and click on "Local Files"
[*]There's a folder called "Saves for apocalypse open beta"
[*]Inside it, there are 2 archives: SaveAllMetaAllApoc and SaveAllMetaNoApoc
[*]Now, in another window, head over to %Appdata%/../LocalLow/Ishtar Games/The Last Spell/Save/Steam/[YOURSTEAMID]/Profile 1
[*]Open the SaveAllMetaAllApoc archive, open the "Profile 1" folder, and copy the "AppSaveBeta.bin" file in your own "Profile 1" folder in %Appdata%/../LocalLow/Ishtar Games/The Last Spell/Save/Steam/[YOURSTEAMID]/Profile 1
[*]Do the same for SaveAllMetaNoApoc with your "Profile 2" folder. [/list]
The SaveAllMetaAllApoc has all the meta of the game unlocked, as well as all the apocalypses, and noted as "Finished". 
The SaveAllMetaNoApoc has all the meta of the game unlocked, but not the apocalypse modifiers.

[u][b]IF YOU WANT TO USE YOUR VERY OWN SAVE:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]In your local files, head over to %Appdata%/../LocalLow/Ishtar Games/The Last Spell/Save/Steam/[YOURSTEAMID]/
[*]Go to the profile you want to use
[*]Duplicate the "AppSave.bin", and rename the new file to "AppSaveBeta.bin"
[/list]
ONLY USE A DUPLICATE OF YOUR FILE. DO NOT DIRECTLY RENAME YOUR SAVE FILE, AS IT VERY LIKELY BREAK IT WHEN YOU GO BACK TO THE MAIN BRANCH OF THE GAME!

One final note: if you want to use your very own save, you can technically continue an apocalypse save in progress. You just need to duplicate the "GameSave.bin" file and rename the copy to "GameSaveBeta.bin".

[b]The beta is now FINISHED! Thank you so much for taking part in it[/b]

[b][u][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeEA9G8i1AOOT07jnqicz88cGGSQz0jn8On_zXLMR0qhw9XDg/viewform?usp=header]We made a little feedback form for you, so please fill it once you feel you've played enough of it![/url]
[/u][/b]

Please fill this form before January 29th at 12:00CET.
If you want to talk with us and the rest of the community about this beta,[url=https://discord.com/invite/ishtargames] please head to our Discord server![/url]

notes.title: Ho ho ho! The Christmas clawers are back, with their best outfits yet!
notes.content:
Hello Warriors!

We hope you're okay for the holidays season! At Ishtar Games, the celebrations have definitely started already with our traditional Christmas tree!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/bb23bd2b67856a0db76bd6063cce9eca4a533579.jpg[/img]
[i](Pictured: people of Ishtar Games who love the holidays season)[/i]

However, not everything we made for the holidays is so cute.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/75c3312a7316f476811ae76a5954f89af3178ceb.jpg[/img]
This thing is called "Georgio", and yes, it's terrifying when it's the first "person" you see in the morning in the office.

But since the holidays spirit is something we want to share with you all, we thought we might give you a liiiiittle something for this season!

[h2]CHRISTMAS CLAWERS ARE BAAAAAAACK[/h2]

We wanted to celebrate the holidays season with you, and what better way than having some VERY special clawers to bring gifts to you? (the gift being death and destruction)

And for this year, we have even more seasonal clawers than before. Are you prepared to spot them all? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/b8fc029a7c2e537f357c3d49c292506fe2f68059.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/74b030dcade654c096bf329ad2052c6d913f18fe.gif[/img]

[i](Yes, we believe he's cute, please don't hurt his feelings)[/i]

We've heard that if you were good heroes this year, [b]we miiight have a "throwback" present for you all right after the holidays[/b]. This should make some of the early fans of The Last Spell very happy ;)

So, have fun with our very special clawers (we know you're going to obliterate them with violence though), and enjoy the holidays!

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Seasonal Clawers can be part of the hordes of enemies! (Cosmetic only, no special effect)
[*]Fixed an issue where loading a save would change the visual aspect of enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Share your best Christmas Clawers on our Discord server![/h2]

We invite you to come to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ishtargames]Discord server [/url] and share your best screenshots of those Christmas Clawers!

We'll repost our favourite ones next month!

And yes, we're very much working hard on DLC2, and we will have more info about it in January!

This should be our very last blogpost for this year! We want to thank you for your incredible support in 2024, and we hope you'll love what we're cooking for next year!


Take care <3

notes.title: The future of The Last Spell: new Roadmap revealed!
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

It's been a while since we gave you big news about The Last Spell, and we're very excited to finally give you some updates about the future of the game!

[h2]What's next for The Last Spell?[/h2]

Our main goal since the beginning of early access has always stayed the same: how can we improve the game even more as we listen to the community and bring new content that we want to make for the game?

This is why, for the past few months, we've been working tiredlessly on the game, tweaking and searching which ideas would be the most exciting for players, new and veterans!

Aaaand we're VERY happy to finally be able to present you the [b]2025 Roadmap for The Last Spell!![/b]

[h2]The Last (?) Roadmap!!![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/d723775d8e10fc197ceebb66675edcb40808cd7c.png[/img]

With this roadmap, you can be sure that there's still quite a lot more to come for The Last Spell in the coming months ;)

I'm sure you have about a million questions about this new roadmap, but don't worry, all questions will be revealed when the time comes.

Now, a few notes about it to give you juuust a bit more info:
[list]

[*] We want each DLC to bring a free update that will make it exciting for all players to return to the game.

[*] Oh, and that Apocalypse 2.0 thing? Yeah, we're doing it. Trust me, it's going to be THAT good.

[*] As for the [b]modding[/b], we know some of you played with quite a lot of them on Nexus Mods ;) But we still want to bring more "official" mod support. We'll have more to reveal about mods later.

[*] Without telling you too much about it, the "Late 2025 DLC" will be VERY different from Dwarves of Runenberg and the next DLC.

[/list]

[h2]Save Slots: November 2024!![/h2]

And since a surprise never comes alone, we have an upcoming update for next month: the [b]save slots!![/b]

This feature was requested quite a lot, and next month, you'll be able to have several save slots at the same time in the game. You won't need to delete your entire progress as much now!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/5c3aeabcbe219b44f61e2367e918f78858fbb05d.png[/img]

I think that was all for today! Take care of yourselves <3

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3.3
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

In today's update we are only bringing bug fixing to the game, which includes a [b]permanent fix for the Steam Deck issue![/b] We worked hard on this one and you should not experience any more trouble regarding the controller on this platform.

You'll find the full bug fixing details below.

[quote]In this update we are also adding [b]in-game analytics[/b] to gather statistics that will provide us a deeper understanding about how you are winning, losing and enjoying The Last Spell. 

Since the game's launch in 2021, we've relied solely on your written feedback and while we love to read all of your comments, it is sometimes not precise enough for an optimal balancing. With these new game analytics we will get raw data to dissect & study, allowing us to make more informed decisions for future updates and in the end, better improve The Last Spell.

These game analytics will be [b]anonymous[/b] and include: how many gold & materials you generate throughout your run, what's your kill rate per skill per weapon, which wave did you fail the most for each map, etc...

If you're uncomfortable about the game analytics, you can turn it off at any moment in the Settings of The Last Spell under the "Other" tab.[/quote]

Thank you and enjoy your Nights!

[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the perk [b]Bodycount Contest[/b] didn't give the correct amount of XP when playing with the "Omen of Weakened Hordes" in Boundless mode, or in Apocalypse II or higher
[*] Fixed an issue where a character with the [b]One-Armed[/b] trait could equip two-handed weapons after unlocking the [b]Specialist [/b]perk
[*] Fixed an issue where the perks [b]Warcry [/b]and [b]Heart of the Party[/b] did not apply to heroes positioned in a watchtower
[*] Buff of [b]Shower of Blows[/b] perk resets every turn but tooltip didn't mentioned it. It doesn't reset every turn anymore
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Warshield [/b]perk was not decrementing after using warshield skills
[*] Adjusted the camera zoom to prevent excessively deep zooming on barks on the Steam Deck and PC low resolutions and to improve readability
[*] Fixed an issue where the tavern didn't update the roster of heroes when it was rebuilt after being destroyed. Also, fixed an issue where the tavern didn't generates a roster of heroes taking into account your current heroes' levels. 
[*] "Controller bug" on Steam Deck is now permanently fixed, previous fix was still unstable
[*] Resolved an issue where [b]Momentum [/b]tooltips would persist on screen if the player changed characters using shortcuts
[*] Added the missing dwarf head icon next to the name of scrolls from the DLC
[*] Fixed a localization issue causing incorrect night rewards display on Runenberg. Other night victories throughout the Runenberg run didn't match the night won by the player
[*] Fixed a localization issue, in french a <nbsp> tag was displayed on the saved message
[*] Fixed a bug where disabling DLC after starting it without unlocking Dwarves/Runenberg in the Oraculum caused a soft lock due to the game still attempting validation of these meta upgrades
[*] Fixed an UI issue where the [b]isolation [/b]attribute is sometimes not displayed in the damage calculation
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Overheat [/b]perk was no longer displayed when the user switches a cannon with another weapon between two weapons slots
[*] Fixed an incorrect display of Mana/Health Cost for Items with [b]Blood Magic[/b] perk
[*] Fixed an issue where Geo reservoir's bonus range is not updated when a "Skill range" bonus is applied from another perk 
[/list]
Thank you for reading this blogpost! Keep sharing your feedback, your ideas and your issues: we'll do our best to correct & fix them 🔥

Join us on [url=discord.gg/ishtargames][b]Discord[/b][/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ishtar_games][b]Twitter[/b][/url] & [url=https://www.instagram.com/ishtar_games/][b]Instagram[/b][/url] to discuss with the team and other players!

notes.title: Patch Note 1.1.2.2
notes.content:
Hello Heroes! 

Since the launch of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795980/The_Last_Spell__Dwarves_of_Runenberg/]Dwarves of Runenberg DLC[/url][/b], we've kept a close eye on all the feedback shared by the players, either on Steam, Discord or Reddit. Today, we're bringing you the changes we specifically crafted based upon your comments and discussions: we have adjusted the Gauntlet, changed the Cannon and better balanced Runenberg & its Final Night.

Find all the details below and enjoy your runs 🔥

[h1]BALANCING[/h1]

[h2]Gauntlet[/h2]
[h3]Overall[/h3]
[list]
[*] Base DMG at level 0 for Novice variation: 56-86 → 84-101
[*] Base DMG at level 0 for other variations: 60-90 → 91-108
[/list]
[h3]Geo Reservoir (Perk)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed Bonus DMG
[*] Range Bonus: +5 → +6, increased by 3 for each of the Hero’s Skill Range attribute
[*] Added Undodgeable
[*] Added Vision
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/8f8c09420080955d3f27b9c668267bd643ef1f1f.png[/img]

[h3]Snap (Skill 1)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Range: 1-1 → 1-2
[*] No longer Skill Range Modifiable (but Geo Reservoir will still improve its range)
[*] Uses per turn: 4 → 5
[*] Opportunism Multiplier: x1.5 → x1.6
[*] Secondary tiles DMG multiplier: x0.6 → x0.3
[*] Secondary tiles: Added Debuff -8/9/10/12/14/16 Resistance (2 turns)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/3b5c3b1b6b58536d947276a898ce28b2a2313d1a.png[/img]

[h3]Shockwave (Skill 2)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Range: 1-1 → 1-2
[*] No longer Skill Range Modifiable (but Geo Reservoir will still improve its range)
[*] Action Points cost: 1 → 2
[*] Mana cost: 2 → 0
[*] Uses per turn: 3 → 2
[*] Propagation bounces: 3 → 5 (4 hits → 6 hits total)
[*] Removed Armor Debuff
[*] Added Debuff -1 Move (2 turns)
[*] Added Inaccuracy x2
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/bcc56bd17f2e2305b186314c0bc154f94d6ca234.png[/img]

[h3]Geo Cannon (Skill 3)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Range: 1-1 → 1-2
[*] No longer Skill Range Modifiable (but Geo Reservoir will still improve its range)
[*] Damage multiplier x1 → x1.25
[*] Added Unblockable
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/feb17b715da61474fc1b8c5c5473dcad894d85bd.png[/img]

[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adept’s Gauntlet bonus: +2/3/4/5/6/7% Prop DMG → +7/8/9/10/11/12 Mana & +3/3/4/4/5/5 Daily Mana Regen
[*] Master’s Gauntlet bonus: +6/8/10/12/14/16% Critical → +1/1/1/1/2/2 Skill Range
[*] Archmaster’s Gauntlet bonus: +1/1/1/1/2/2 Skill Range → +1/1/1/1/2/2 Propagation Bounces
[/list]
[h2]Cannon[/h2]
[h3]Overheat (Perk)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health Cost while Overheating formula: 4 + 6 for each base AP and Mana cost → 4 + 4 for each base AP and Mana Cost
[*] Fire Blast base DMG: 101-160 → 82-130
[/list]
[h3]Cannon Ball (Skill 1)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health Cost while Overheating: 16 → 12
[/list]
[h3]Rocket Jump (Skill 2)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health Cost while Overheating: 10 → 8
[*] Now have a range modifier
[/list]
[h3]Mortar (Skill 3)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost: 2 → 1
[*] Heat generated: 4 → 3
[*] Health Cost while Overheating: 28 → 16
[*] Secondary tiles: Stun chance: 60% → 50%
[/list]
[h3]Armageddon (Skill 4)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost: 4 → 3
[*] Heat generated: 7 → 6
[*] Health Cost while Overheating: 46 → 28
[*] Added Vision
[/list]
[h3]Scrolls[/h3]

[u][b]Geo Cannon Scroll[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost: 2/3/4 → 5/6/7 (it was an oversight)
[/list]
[u][b]Armageddon Scroll[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Mana Cost: 3/4/5 → 5/6/7
[/list]
[h2]Heroes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Human heroes can now use "Jump over" to jump over a runestone
[/list]
[h2]Runenberg[/h2]
[list]
[*] Non-boss nights’ difficulty was adjusted, it should now be more in line difficulty-wise with the Final Night
[*] Fix Night slider progression (Boss Meter) on Runenberg: when new corrupted runestones appear the slider will now progress
[*] Boss night’s pacing and difficulty have been improved, it should now take less turns to defeat it
[*] There are now more enemies in nights 2-7 (mainly T1 enemies), which means Heroes will gain more EXP before the Boss night
[*] Night Rewards start at higher values, for both items and resources.
[*] Corrupted runestones are now more visible, which should help when there is a lot of enemies on screen. We'll be happy to hear what you think about this visual change in particular!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/8281e902984c08382924a8537d848cfb1f42a745.png[/img]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Dwarves statues' health not increasing in Apocalypse modes
[*] Fixed the 'Collateral damage Medal' perk, its skill 'Collateral hit' can no longer target another hero and its AP cost was removed
[*] Carnage perk now reset its stacks properly with Spiky Counter
[*] Fixed the perk 'Heart of the Party', which didn't reset its stack at the start of the round. Now it only takes into account the damage inflicted this turn.
[*] Fixed tooltips on the item "Medal of Like a Shark " which displayed an "Undodgeable" effect when it should be an "Unblockable"
[*] Fixed Game Freezes when the player try to open the night reward with a controller 
[*] Fixed The "Warcry"damage increase feedback icon , the damage bonus was not displayed at the start of the turn
[*] Fixed the "Blocked Damage" stat which was not tracked correctly in both the "Favor system" and the "Lifetimes stats" panel
[*] Fixed item perks being definetely attached to a character when equipping 2 items with the same perk (perks that have already been attached to a character will stay in your current game ) 
[*] "Controller bug" on Steam Deck is now fixed, sticks will be responsive in the official layout
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576831/575d4cbd0f98563e4dc981f99bffdff58247316d.png[/img]

Also we provided a fixe for PS4 and PS5 controllers, they are now responsive throughout all features. To make the fix effective please: 
[list]
[*] Go to [b]%Appdata%/../LocalLow/Ishtar Games/The Last Spell/Save/Steam[/b] (copy/paste this path on the file explorer)
[*] Open folder named with your steam ID (a sequence of numbers)
[*] Delete the file InputMappingSave in your folder 
[*] This operation will delete your keyboard preferences, unfortunately, we don't have any other solution to fix this issue
[/list]
Thank you for reading this blogpost! Keep sharing your feedback, your ideas and your issues: we'll do our best to correct & fix them 🔥

Join us on [url=discord.gg/ishtargames][b]Discord[/b][/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ishtar_games][b]Twitter[/b][/url] & [url=https://www.instagram.com/ishtar_games/][b]Instagram[/b][/url] to discuss with the team and other players!

notes.title: Upcoming updates for The Last Spell
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

Last week, we released Dwarves of Runenberg, the first DLC of The Last Spell! If you missed the news, this new DLC introduces three new weapons, a new race, a brand new map and new items called "Medals". You can find more information here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1105670/view/7454095233531526552

Following the release, we've kept a close eye on all the feedback shared by players, either on Steam forums, Reddit or [url=discord.gg/ishtargames]Discord[/url] (join us over there, everyone is awesome!). We've noted multiple things and we will work on them accordingly to better balance the game but it will take some time, since in France we have multiple public holidays in May which affect the pace of the production.

[h2]Dwarves of Runenberg Updates[/h2]

Earlier this week, we released an update ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1105670/view/4191238396457528858][b]Patch 1.1.1.4[/b][/url]) which was planned before the release of the DLC. It fixed multiples issues and brought a few features to the game.

We knew it wouldn't address your issues & feedback but rest assured: [b]we absolutely plan to make further updates![/b] The next one is planned to be released on [b]the week of May 13[/b]. This additional time will help us to better analyze your feedback and properly test our changes before giving you access to it.

[h3]This new patch will include:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Balancing on the Final Night of Runenberg 
[*] Gauntlet balancing
[*] Improving the Runestones' visibility on Runenberg
[*] Correctly display the Boss Meter progress on Runenberg
[/list]
Thank you for reading this blogpost! Keep sharing your feedback, your ideas and your issues: we'll do our best to correct & fix them 🔥

Join us on [url=discord.gg/ishtargames][b]Discord[/b][/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ishtar_games][b]Twitter[/b][/url] & [url=https://www.instagram.com/ishtar_games/][b]Instagram[/b][/url] to discuss with the team and other players!
